visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a stunning close-up of a fresh strawberry cake roll, showcasing its fluffy sponge and rich cream filling. Two men, a host in a blue denim jacket and a professional chef in a white apron and hairnet, introduce the session in a brightly lit, modern commercial kitchen studio filled with stainless steel equipment. (2) Transition to an outdoor scene showing the storefront of Le Ruban Patisserie where a crowd of people is queuing under lush green trees. Inside, the camera pans across display cases filled with intricate pastries, including canelés and various fruit tarts, highlighting the retail environment's warm lighting and elegant presentation. (3) The chef demonstrates the preparation process on a large sheet of sponge cake. He carefully manipulates parchment paper to create folds, then slices the golden-brown sponge precisely in half. The scene focus shifts to the detailed application of white whipped cream using a metal spatula, followed by the orderly placement of halved strawberries. (4) Further detail is shown as the chef pipes lines of dark red strawberry jam and a pale jasmine ganache onto the cream. He then uses a rolling pin and the parchment paper to expertly roll the cake into a tight cylinder. The rolled cakes are placed into a large, industrial blast chiller with multiple internal shelves. (5) The host and chef discuss techniques while sitting at a table. The chef uses a blowtorch to heat a long metal knife before slicing the chilled cake roll, resulting in a perfectly clean cut. The host enthusiastically tastes a slice, expressing joy. The video concludes with a QA segment and a branded graphic outro for LINE VOOM on a vibrant green background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy speech from the host, characterized by a fast rate and high pitch variability. An upbeat, acoustic-style background music with a steady rhythmic beat accompanies the dialogue. The environment is a clean studio with minimal background noise. (2) As the tutorial begins, the vocal tone shifts to a professional and informative style from the chef. The BGM continues at a moderate volume. Audible incidental noises include the crisp rustling of parchment paper and the soft thud of objects on the stainless steel counter. (3) A distinct mechanical clicking and the continuous hiss of a blowtorch are heard as the chef heats the knife. This is followed by the sharp, clean sound of a knife slicing through the cake's crust. The host's vocal arousal increases with expressive gasps and sounds of satisfaction while eating. (4) During the QA segment, the dialogue becomes more conversational with natural pauses and a friendly tone. The background music maintains its tempo until the very end, where a bright, synthesized brand jingle for LINE VOOM plays, concluding the audio track with a clear, high-fidelity finish.
